description:
Zamek na Skale stands in a 13-hectare park beside a mountain river, in the village of Trzebieszowice, just west of the spa town of Lądek-Zdrój in Lower Silesia's Kłodzko Land. The building began as a Renaissance residence in the 16th century and was reshaped over the following centuries, though its later owners and the dates of those alterations are not well enough documented to state here with confidence.

Today the castle operates as a hotel, spa and restaurant, and is a member of the Historic Hotels of Europe association, a network recognising historic properties across the continent. Guided tours of the castle's interiors run on certain days, giving even non-residents a way to see inside the building.

Accommodation is split between rooms in the castle itself and a separate annex building within the grounds, so it's worth checking which part of the property a given room belongs to before booking. The surrounding park, with its mountain-river setting, is as much a part of the stay as the historic building.

faqs.question: Are all the rooms at Zamek na Skale inside the castle itself?
faqs.answer: No — accommodation is split between rooms in the castle and rooms in a separate annex building within the grounds. Check which building a room is in when you book.

faqs.question: Can I see inside the castle without staying overnight?
faqs.answer: Yes — guided tours of the castle's interiors run on certain days. Check current times with the hotel before planning a visit.

hotel.how_to_stay:
**Getting there:** In the village of Trzebieszowice, just west of the spa town of Lądek-Zdrój in Lower Silesia's Kłodzko Land, in a park beside a mountain river.

**Rooms & rates:** From approx. €100/night for a 17 m² double in the castle annex, a separate building, with breakfast and unlimited spa access included on the rate seen; rooms in the castle itself start around €110.

**On-site:** An indoor swimming pool and spa, a restaurant, a billiards room and meeting rooms in the castle; the grounds include a 13-hectare park, and bicycles and Nordic-walking gear are available.

**Good to know:** Check which building a room is in when you book: the cheapest rooms are in a separate castle annex rather than in the castle itself. Guided castle tours run on certain days, so check times with the hotel.

**Combine with:** The spa town of Lądek-Zdrój and the Kłodzko Land mountains; [Książ Castle](/castles/poland/ksiaz-castle) is the nearest big Lower Silesia castle.
